## Tujuan Pembelajaran

- Memahami perintah-perintah dasar **Git**
- Membuat repositori Git lokal dan daring (**GitHub**)
- Menambahkan **remote** antara repositori lokal & GitHub
- Memahami **branching**, **merge/pull request**
- Memahami **environment variable**
- Men-**deploy** proyek Django ke **PWS**

# Persiapan Awal

## Akun GitHub

- **Git**: sistem kontrol versi untuk melacak perubahan kode
- **GitHub**: platform kolaborasi berbasis Git
- Buat akun di [github.com](https://github.com) kalau belum punya

## Instalasi IDE

- Pilih *text editor*/IDE (mis. VS Code)
- Install sesuai OS masing-masing
- Kenali fitur dasar: buka folder, terminal terintegrasi, ekstensi

# Instalasi & Konfigurasi Git

## Instalasi Git

- Install Git sesuai OS (Windows/macOS/Linux)
- Verifikasi: `git --version`

## Konfigurasi Identitas

```bash
git config --global user.name "<NAME>"
git config --global user.email "<EMAIL>"
```

- Konfigurasi ini menempel di setiap commit yang kamu buat

## Konfigurasi Autentikasi & Verifikasi

- Setup autentikasi GitHub (token/SSH)
- Cek ulang dengan `git config --list`

# Penggunaan Dasar Git

## Inisiasi & Remote

- `git init` — inisiasi repositori lokal
- Buat repositori kosong di GitHub
- `git remote add origin <url>` — hubungkan lokal ↔ GitHub

## Clone & Branching

- `git clone <url>` — salin repositori ke lokal
- `git branch`, `git checkout -b <nama-branch>`
- Pull Request / Merge Request untuk gabungkan perubahan

# Proyek Django

## Setup Proyek

- Buat virtual environment, aktifkan
- `pip install -r requirements.txt`
- `django-admin startproject <nama_proyek> .`

## Environment Variables

- Simpan konfigurasi sensitif di luar kode (`.env`)
- Jangan commit file `.env` — cek `.gitignore`

## Jalankan & Unggah

- `python manage.py runserver` untuk cek lokal
- `git add`, `git commit`, `git push` ke GitHub

# Deployment ke PWS

## Deploy ke Pacil Web Service

- Buat akun PWS
- Tambahkan URL deployment ke `ALLOWED_HOSTS`
- Push ke remote PWS untuk trigger deploy

## Troubleshooting Umum

- Build gagal → cek log build
- Credentials tidak tersimpan → cek konfigurasi Git
- Error 502 → tunggu proses build selesai / cek `Procfile`

## Referensi & Penutup

- Dokumentasi lengkap: lihat halaman [Tutorial 0](../tutorial/tutorial-0.qmd)
- Pertanyaan? Tanyakan ke asisten dosen di sesi lab

## Learning Objectives

- Understand basic **Git** commands
- Create a local and online Git repository (**GitHub**)
- Add a **remote** between a local repository & GitHub
- Understand **branching**, **merge/pull requests**
- Understand **environment variables**
- **Deploy** a Django project to **PWS**

# Getting Started

## GitHub Account

- **Git**: version control system for tracking code changes
- **GitHub**: Git-based collaboration platform
- Create an account at [github.com](https://github.com) if you don't have one

## Installing an IDE

- Choose a *text editor*/IDE (e.g. VS Code)
- Install it for your OS
- Get familiar with basic features: opening folders, integrated terminal, extensions

# Git Installation & Configuration

## Installing Git

- Install Git for your OS (Windows/macOS/Linux)
- Verify: `git --version`

## Identity Configuration

```bash
git config --global user.name "<NAME>"
git config --global user.email "<EMAIL>"
```

- This configuration is attached to every commit you make

## Authentication Setup & Verification

- Set up GitHub authentication (token/SSH)
- Double-check with `git config --list`

# Basic Git Usage

## Init & Remote

- `git init` — initialize a local repository
- Create an empty repository on GitHub
- `git remote add origin <url>` — connect local ↔ GitHub

## Clone & Branching

- `git clone <url>` — copy a repository locally
- `git branch`, `git checkout -b <branch-name>`
- Pull Request / Merge Request to combine changes

# Django Project

## Project Setup

- Create and activate a virtual environment
- `pip install -r requirements.txt`
- `django-admin startproject <project_name> .`

## Environment Variables

- Keep sensitive configuration outside the code (`.env`)
- Never commit the `.env` file — check `.gitignore`

## Run & Push

- `python manage.py runserver` to check locally
- `git add`, `git commit`, `git push` to GitHub

# Deployment to PWS

## Deploy to Pacil Web Service

- Create a PWS account
- Add the deployment URL to `ALLOWED_HOSTS`
- Push to the PWS remote to trigger a deploy

## Common Troubleshooting

- Build fails → check the build log
- Credentials not saved → check your Git configuration
- Error 502 → wait for the build to finish / check `Procfile`

- Full documentation: see the [Tutorial 0](../tutorial/tutorial-0.qmd) page
